description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. It is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh: 数据库名称。支持同时传入多个数据库，多个数据库名称之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The name of the database. To specify multiple databases, separate the names with a comma (,).

title.zh: 撤销边缘集群账号对数据库的访问权限

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb revoke-account-privilege-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --account-name testacc --db-name testdb --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb RevokeAccountPrivilegeZonal --region cn-hangzhou --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --DBName testdb --ClientToken 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --AccountName testacc
